title: Optimize Console: recommendation cards, config change preview, and immutable activity log for safe rollback
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem statement: Customers want automated, actionable cost-optimization suggestions (batching and caching profiles) surfaced in the Console, and a reliable way to preview, apply, and if needed, roll back configuration changes without risking request quality or violating SLAs. Current prototype shows recommendations but lacks a robust diff preview, operator metadata, and an immutable activity trail that satisfies enterprise audit requirements.

Goals: 1) Build a small, focused UI surface inside Optimize that displays recommendation cards with estimated savings, confidence score, and quick-preview of affected routes/models. 2) Provide a side-by-side config diff preview for any change the recommendation will apply (including batching, KV cache TTL, quantization profile), with clear indicators of risk and regression vectors. 3) Implement a server-side immutable activity log (audit trail) that records who/what applied a change, the exact before/after config, and a one-click safe rollback path that replays the previous config with compatibility checks. 4) Ensure all actions are logged to KMS-backed audit store and surfaced in Console with filtering by time, actor, route, and model.

Non-goals: This ticket does not include autoscaling policy changes or direct runtime kernel optimizations; those will be handled in follow-ups. This scope also excludes CLI automation and focuses on Console-driven UX + backend audit entries.

Key success metrics: - Adoption: % of Optimize recommendations viewed and applied within 14 days. - Safety: % of applied recommendations that trigger automated rollback within 72 hours (target: <1%). - Observability: Time-to-investigation for applied-change incidents reduced by 40% via activity log. - Cost: measurable average token-cost reduction for routes where recommendations applied (baseline tracked in experiment).
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation cards show: title, short explanation, estimated monthly savings, confidence (low/med/high), impacted model/route list and a link to 'preview change'

Preview modal shows a line-by-line config diff for the route(s) affected, with syntax highlighting for keys like batch_size, max_tokens, kv_cache_ttl_ms, quant_profile, and an estimate of latency impact
Apply flow requires an explicit confirmation with a 'dry-run' option that runs compatibility checks against a canary subset of traffic (configurable) and reports a compatibility score

Immutable activity log entry created for every apply/rollback containing: timestamp, actor (user or system), full before/after configs (raw JSON), optional evaluation snapshot link, and a reference to the recommendation id
Rollback is one-click from the activity log and verifies compatibility before activating the old config; rollback should be recorded as a new immutable entry
Admins can filter activity log by actor, route, model, time range, and recommendation id; exportable CSV for audit teams
All audit entries are stored with integrity checks and retention policy configurable per org (UI and backend required)
notes: Trade-offs discussed: showing too much config detail may overwhelm non-technical PMs; we choose a concise diff by default with an 'expand raw JSON' for power users.
Security: storing pre/post configs requires redaction of secrets and keys; backend will canonicalize and redact KMS references before persisting.
Data retention: default 90 days for audit trail in hosted plans, configurable to 1 year for enterprise via release add-on; storage cost TBD with infra team.
Rollback safety: perform a compatibility dry-run against synthetically generated requests to detect schema/regression issues before activating rollback.
